notes.title: ( ͡◉ ͜ʖ ͡◉) ROBBIE SWIFTHAND NOW ON FULL RELEASE!!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/1cae65eec55f93999ce6ce6231854cca95df498e.png

After 20 months of relentless development… After 1,9 metric tons of coffee... After close to two billion times we told our studio cats “please don’t do that thing you do with the wires”... After 130.000 global deaths... The day has come.

*QUEUE THE EXPLOSIONS*
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/44ce7e88b8834df136f4fe46ee273850f9837703.png


Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries… is now FULLY RELEASED ON STEAM!!11!!11! (NO CLICKBAIT)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4eRXan0PuRE

A sincere, sleep-deprived THANK YOU to everyone that has been with us since the early access version<3 The journey was long and arduous, but together WE PREVAILED!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c2bcb8e3ecfad7321390077d0f7f3b351f85c3c8.png

Please enjoy the full Robbie-killing, wall-twisting, spike-sharp experience! 

For those that have yet to taste what a day (some hours at a time) in the life of Robbie Swifthand feels like, WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?!!?!!1?!?!?!!?!!11?!1?!1

For any feedback or questions please feel free to join our discord server here!

Even though we just released the game - that doesn't mean there is no room for improvement! We still want to add the following:

 More achievements to unlock!
 Trading Cards!
 Cloud Saves!
 Optimization and minor graphics setting (turn blood on/off, optional frame cap)
 AND MORE!!1!1!



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7daad77478924cf1bcf2940fdcca4883acb894ed.png
AND NOW, WE CELEBRATE(or fall asleep on the couches)!!1!11!11!!!!1

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/660540b19f05dc891909307726eceb576efcd039.png

Thank you for reading this wall of text ( ͡☉ ͜ʖ ͡☉)

notes.title: ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ GAMESCOM! DISCORD?!? RELEASE DATE??!?!?!ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7e76338ec79adf9948181d2ed426d501b8ed499b.png

We hope you have been enjoying summer vacations since our last update! Summer is the time for relaxation, leisure and rest from work! In contrast we decided to focus and keeps ourselves busy preparing exciting stuff for you to enjoy once summer ends!

What do we mean by that? That the FULL RELEASE of Robbie Swifthand And the Orb of Mysteries is coming up at the 20th of September 2018!! 

WHO’S AS HYPED AS WE ARE ABOUT THIS?!!? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c2bcb8e3ecfad7321390077d0f7f3b351f85c3c8.png

With that being said we would like to invite everyone to give us their input for changes, fixes, pretty much anything you think would help us make the game perfect before the release!

For that purpose we created a secret club in our Discord Server 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7daad77478924cf1bcf2940fdcca4883acb894ed.png

Here is how to get in our super secret feedback club:

1.Go to our discord server and click on the #secret_clubs channel
2.React with Robbie’s face on the post shown on the image
3.Now you’ll notice that “Pixel Reign Games” are available for you to join and post


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/0adf4a4878d1e3010cea6f0599dcdf3ca36a0a28.png

We are looking forward to talk with anyone interested!

We also wanted to share with you that this year we will be attending  Gamescom ! We’re super excited and proud for that achievement as well as thankful for you people for helping us throughout our journey to improve our game on a consistent basis <3

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/253a8c3d9d5baa6c24a3163fe3d437bdba40801e.png

If you happen to attend Gamescom this year please do come and say hi! We will be located at the Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.1 Booth A20 ) among other magnificent games made by great developers!  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png

Thank you for reading this wall of text ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ

notes.title: Early February Update Notes and Upcoming Content
notes.notes:
A new temple area is close to release in which EVERYTHING is different! Even a mysterious female character was added so who’s up for some news about what’s happening in the world of Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries?!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b0e0c75c4d96ee957ddcc0e09de26964b9c1ea68.png

Fellow reader we know that a month has passed since our previous post announcement (or millenia in Steam Early Access time equivalence ) so we hope to meet your expectations with this one!

For a starter we would like to mention that small changes have been made in the early stages of the first temple area so new players can have a little bit more time to get the mechanics of the game before the real challenge starts!

Alongside with that we also added a resolution change setting for users that experience lower framerates. 
(You can lower the resolution by accessing the setting in the menu as shown in the image below)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/f8104624d595dd0644ab2e5079456d4645705637.png

We would also like to announce that if everything goes as planned we will be able to release the second temple area by the end of February - all levels of Normal mode are ready for testing but there is a boss fight and a HELL mode (for lunatics like our Level Designer that enjoy the extra challenge) to craft ahead! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c1d1b3682794f1df0b5eb5763c99006fd08cc6a0.png

We also have a commitment not to release anything un-polished or incomplete so bear with us for a few weeks ( ͡°ω ͡°) 

On the flip side we still have time to tweak some stuff so your feedback would be of great importance to us!

We have released video since the last post announcement so please let us know what you think of our progress:

 Robbie Swifthand - Area 2 Progress 2	

Any feedback is welcome - our aim is to craft a game that will be as good as we can make it so no sugarcoating, let us know what you think!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png

If you would like to see more of our content check out our  facebook	,   instagram	 or  twitter	 where you can also follow us to be notified about our latest work.

Thank you for reading this wall of text and we hope you stick around for more ( ͡ʘ ͜ʖ ͡ʘ)
